title: Chug Life Choices
subtitle: The Fortnite Would You Rather book: impossible dilemmas, brilliant arguments, no wrong answers
version_note: Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), Fortnitemares update v42.40. Game facts checked on 18 October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book of would-you-rather dilemmas: loot, places, powers, squads and some truly ridiculous choices, with the case for both sides.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Here's one last would-you-rather: learn three of these this week, or learn five? (Trick question. Five.)

chapters.title: You Have to Choose
chapters.toc: How to play, and the one rule you can't break
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: Thirty-five impossible choices. No skipping, no sitting on the fence, and absolutely no saying "both".

chapters.title: Loadout Lunacy
chapters.toc: Chug Jugs, golden guns and rideable rockets
chapters.dek: Your inventory has five slots and you can't have everything. Time to make some painful decisions.

chapters.title: Island Hopping
chapters.toc: Where you'd land, live and lose your way
chapters.dek: Theme parks, temples, mazes and ski lodges. Where would you go, and could you ever leave?

chapters.title: Power Trip
chapters.toc: Pick your superpower, then live with it
chapters.dek: Dashes, fangs, X-ray goggles and enormous heads. Every power has a price.

chapters.title: Squad Goals
chapters.toc: Who you'd play with, and how you'd decide
chapters.dek: Fortnite is more fun with friends. It is also more complicated.

chapters.title: Absolutely Absurd
chapters.toc: Dancing, shouting, llamas and rubber ducks
chapters.dek: No strategy. No sense. Just choices so silly that you'll have to think very seriously about them.

chapters.title: Big Thinkers
chapters.toc: Time, fame, honesty and getting better
chapters.dek: The hardest choices in the book, and the ones grown-ups argue about too.

chapters.title: Your Turn
chapters.toc: Spot the sneaky argument, then write your own

chapters.dek: How to tell a fair choice from a trick one, how to decide like a scientist, and how to build a would-you-rather that nobody can answer.
